svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build the base and drawer-tower case with its internal plywood L / C grip members.
2. Build all THREE drawers for THIS tower, keeping IDs with their respective drawers.
3. Check the selected runners against the modelled side gap before final drawer sizing.
4. Dry-fit fronts and test movement; do not notch the outside panels.
5. This tower shares the centre structure / back: complete its final fixing with the TV centre.
